title: Missing input validation on `createAuction` function parameters can lead to loss of value
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as it can lead to stuck funds  **Likelihood:** Low, as it requires user error/misconfiguration  ## Description  There are some problems with the input validation in `createAuction`, more specifically related to the timestamp values.  1. `endTimestamp` can be equal to `startTimestamp`, so `duration` will be 0 2. `endTimestamp` can be much further in the future than `startTimestamp`, so `duration` will be a huge number and the auction may never end 3.
